# ClipForge

ClipForge is a pay-per-view clipping marketplace at https://clipforge-pied-rho.vercel.app.

## What it is

Brands run clipping campaigns: they set a budget cap and a per-view rate, fund their balance up front (prepay only), and clippers post short clips about the brand. Clippers earn money for every verified view their clips get. ClipForge keeps a standard 20% cut on brand spend. There are no subscriptions, setup fees, or seat charges.

## For clippers

- Connect social accounts (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X) and verify ownership with a unique code placed in the account bio. Accounts need at least 1,000 followers.
- Browse live campaigns, submit clip links from verified accounts.
- Every clip is reviewed by an admin before view tracking starts.
- Views are verified: YouTube via the YouTube Data API, Instagram via a view-tracking integration. Spike detection flags unnatural view patterns for manual review.
- Earnings settle in monthly payout cycles. The payout minimum is $10; smaller balances carry forward to the next month.

## For brands

- Request brand access, pick a budget range (under $1K, $1K–$5K, $5K–$25K, $25K+), set a per-view rate and budget cap per campaign.
- Spend can never exceed the cap: campaigns pause automatically when the budget runs out.
- Live dashboard shows verified views per clip, spend against cap, and per-clipper reach.
- Campaigns can set minimum view thresholds per post as a quality filter.

## Trust and safety

- Admin review on every clip before tracking.
- Verified-view counting from official sources, not self-reported numbers.
- Fraud detection for fake engagement (viewbots, engagement pods, bought views).
- Grievance Officer page with complaint process under India's IT Act 2000 and DPDP Act 2023: /policies/grievance-officer
